notes.title: Haunting Behaviors Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
v0.9.2.6 Update Notes
Complete ghost overhaul
18 ghost types in Identify, all with unique behaviors that can identified without evidence specific equipment

Ghost behaviors can currently be found in the official TOS Discord

A fully detailed work-up of the behaviors will be available soon for those that want exact numbers

Summerhill Psychiatric Institution location rework
Now contains TWO new favorite eligible rooms, a small break room (not favorite-eligible), and 2 access hallways to help navigate the location better. Along with some changes to the layout of the location, there is also proper color balancing of the environment to get it to the correct horror atmosphere it deserves.

Lobby size increase
Pickup truck now allows for 5 player contracts, and Box Truck allows for 6!

CCTV System
Available only in the Box Truck, view the location through static cameras or other players cellphone cameras!

New Equipment
FLX-POD: Generates an EMF field when powered on, agitating the ghost. Provides audio and visual indicators that the ghost is near, and just how close!

Holy Water Sprayer: Modernized spray bottle that sprays holy water mist that will disorient a hunting ghost.

Old Candle: Placeable candle that can be used to encourage an interaction by the ghost. They can also be found in some locations.

Inventory Overhaul
Features a secondary "Blessed" section that protective items can be placed into.

Visual UI update that provides easier identifying of item types and their uses.

HQ inventory stash screen now displays the location, difficulty, and contract type to help plan accordingly, as well as any issues like missing suggested equipment.


v0.9.2.6-Spire HOTFIX Patch Notes:
Fixed issue causing interaction failures

Fixed issue with FLX POD interaction (turning it off)

Fixed issue that would sometimes cause the holy water to disorient the ghost permanently

Fixed some typo errors in ghost descriptions/names

Applied attenuation to holy water ghost reaction sound


This marks our biggest update yet, and it's not even done yet. Coming soon is the new Cemetery location, Abaddon Hallows! 

We can’t thank the community enough for your patience, support, and continued feedback. Your enthusiasm keeps us building! Like always, if you have any suggestions, or feedback (good or bad), let us know!

notes.title: New map! Version 0.9.2.0 is now live! Easter Event!
notes.notes:
Version 0.9.2.0 Patch Notes

---

Easter Event – Limited Time  
-A special event is now live! While playing in Cleanse mode, after completing the scan, players can collect Ethereal Artifacts disguised as Easter eggs.  
- Collecting these artifacts will unlock exclusive event rewards.  
- Available for a limited time—don’t miss out!

---

New Content & Features  
- New contract location: 1205 Cedar St  
- Added Easy Door open/close gameplay setting  
- Added CC poster furniture to headquarters  
- Added female facial expressions  
- Home digital thermometer is now placeable  
- Players can now move with WASD while using the tablet or phone  
- Contract type, difficulty, and location now display on the phone's main screen  
- Added network failure prompt when returned to main menu  

---

Visual & UI Improvements  
- Updated visual design for Identifier filter  
- Removed evidence guide from the Identify screen  

---

Audio & VOIP  
- Adjusted VOIP sensitivity to reduce microphone cut-out issues  
- Adjusted audio levels for all violent jump scares  

---

Gameplay Balancing  
- Increased cooldown for the slam door event  
- Increased hunt grace period on higher difficulties to allow more time to escape  
- Demon is now more aggressive (experimental change as part of ghost trait system)  

---

Bug Fixes – Ghosts & Events  
- Fixed issue where ghost could spawn inside walls during specific events  
- Fixed issue where the ghost would play the wrong animation at the start of a hunt  
- Fixed issue where the wheelchair event could trap players  

---

Bug Fixes – Equipment & Items  
- Fixed issue where some equipment could block door movement  
- Fixed issue where dead player bodies could prevent doors from opening  
- Adjusted equipment physics to make placing and dropping items smoother and more stable  

---

Bug Fixes – General  
- Fixed slow-motion movement animations when hosting  
- Fixed a crash that could occur when changing keybinds  
- Fixed rare issue where exterior doors could remain open  
- Fixed issue where temperature could be checked through windows  
- Fixed issue where photos awarded money during training  
- Fixed issue where Cleansed and Identified values in Tablet Team Info always displayed as 0  
- Fixed issue where Expert and Master difficulties required one extra correct characteristic in cleanse mode  

---

Other  
- Other minor bug fixes and stability improvements

notes.title: Version 0.9.1.6 (Early Access)
notes.notes:
Version 0.9.1.6 (Early Access)

This update will include all 0.9.1.5 changes that were previously rolled back

What's Fixed?

 Fixed an issue that would cause some anomaly photos to not count for task completion
 Fixed an issue that would cause thrown objects to continuously play sounds long after the item was thrown
 Fixed an issue that would cause the flame on the lighter to not appear on lower Visual Effects settings


What's Changed?

 Removed chromatic aberration effect
 Recommended player count multiplier for location size reduced from 1.5x to 1.2x
 Mansion and Asylum are both now considered Extra Large locations
 Location reward multiplier for Stone Manor Plantation increased from 1.5x to 1.75x
 Location reward multiplier for Summerhill Psychiatric Institution decreased from 1.8x to 1.75x

 Cleanse contract task reward changes as follows
Successful Scan:

 XP: Increased from 100 to 150
 Money: Increased from $200 to $300

Gather All Artifacts:

 XP: Decreased from 80 to 50
 Money: Decreased from $150 to $100


 Identify contract task reward changes as follows
Select Correct Ghost Type:

 XP: Decreased from 200 to 115
 Money: Decreased from $300 to $225




 Various secondary task rewards have been adjusted
 Photos are no longer affected by multipliers
 Streamlined the payout section in the Post Contract screen
 Voice Recognition setting no longer appears in main menu
 Bad Vision tarot effect has been nerfed. You can now see your phone
 Contract difficulty and average sanity now play into how active the ghost is (Interactions, events, and hunts)
 All difficulties have been tweaked
 Changed the angle tolerance for ghost anomaly photos to avoid poor quality tier photos
 Some new interactions in the Entry Room in the Ravenwood Ln location



What's New?

 Host can now honk the horn when seated as the driver in the vehicle
 Female character now has appropriate screams for the Randomly Scream tarot effect
 Cellphone background image customization (More to come for unlockables later)
 Cellphone now has quick app keybinds. These can be found in the Controls section in the settings menu
 Cycling equipment now has customizable keybinds instead of only scroll wheel
 Can now view some ghost stats in the post contract summary:

 Time Spent in Favorite Location
 Interactions Performed
 Events Performed
 Hunts Executed



Ecliptic Studios Dev Team

notes.title: Version 0.9.1.4 (Early Access) Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Version 0.9.1.4 (Early Access) Patch Notes

Hey everyone!

We just wanted to take a moment to thank each and every one of you for your incredible support since our release into early access just over a week ago. The feedback, excitement, and passion you've shown have been nothing short of amazing, and we're truly grateful to have such a dedicated community.

This patch includes a few fixes and improvements based on your feedback, and we can’t wait for you to experience the updates. Your input helps us continue making the game better, and we’re committed to delivering far more content very soon.

Thank you for your patience, your enthusiasm, and your belief in our vision. We couldn’t have done it without you, and we’re so excited for what’s to come!

What's Fixed?

 "Escape a Hunt" task would be completed even if a player died during a hunt
 Vitals would sometimes show incorrect status for players that returned from the astral realm
 Players could clip into the counter in the hydrotherapy room in the psychiatric institution location
 Players would crash in some keybind situations, such as binding the drop key to the rotate item key
 The loaner box would grant money as the fee rather than deduct money
 Players would be granted an increasingly large amount of money/experience for each completed task that would not reflect was the post contract tablet would show. (This fix will slow down overall progression)
 Players could get stuck in the linen closet inside the master bathroom in Ravenwood house location
 Some artifacts were unreachable or unable to be picked up
 Players that are dead and spectating could sometimes not see other dead players
 Fixed several more rare crashes
 Players could sometimes not hear each other when dead and spectating
 Some audio settings would reset to default until the audio settings screen was viewed again


What's Changed?

 Headlamp has been adjusted to provide a less focused and bright light and more of a wide diffused light with a bit less range
 Generic Flashlight has been massively adjusted to provide less light overall with a more realistic visual
 UV Flashlight has been adjusted to provide a more distant light beam with a more realistic visual
 No more trying to get the interaction crosshair right on top of equipment to pick it up. If the indicator is showing, it can now be picked up
 Events will no longer activate during a hunt
 The Ghost Type's visibility in the Post Contract tablet screen has been increased as well as the characteristics and associated levels
 Made the selected ghost type in the Identifier app more apparent and obvious


What's New?

 New Scares in Stone Manor Plantation!
 Dead players can now interact with nearly everything they could while alive, even doors (albeit with a bit weaker strength)
 Ghost phrases image added to the Voice Recognition Test setting in Audio settings
 New phone app: "Speak-EZ". This app will allow you to speak using text phrases. The spirit box will pick up the text phrase if you're in proximity of it (doesn't have to be equipped)
 Notice in the vehicle equipment crate while in contract to notify players that collecting equipment in the crate before returning to the HQ is not required
 Identifier app in cellphone can now filter OUT evidence
 When the Post Contract Summary has been closed in the tablet, it can now be viewed again from the main screen of the HQ tablet


Issues You May Still Encounter

 Voice Recognition Test in settings while in the main menu will not work, but should in the HQ or Contract



 Ecliptic Studios Dev Team

notes.title: Version 0.9.1.3 (Early Access) Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Version 0.9.1.3 (Early Access) Patch Notes
This patch focused on some of the more critical issues

What's Fixed?

 Some players would experience a crash when trying to play multiplayer
 Players could experience a crash when returning to the HQ, with the E.A.L. powered on
 Some players would experience extremely jittery/stuttery mouse when in HQ or Contract
 When transitioning to new HQ locations, players that had equipment contributed would lose access to that equipment until reset


What's Changed?

 Removed the option to adjust the Cellphone Camera's frame rate, it is now locked to half of the average framerate
 Temporarily removed the "Shield During a Hunt" task objective
 The "Escape a Hunt" is now a shared task and can only be completed if no one dies during a hunt in which the ghost has line-of-sight of at least one player


What's New?

 Weather is now dynamic and can change through the duration of the contract, so there may be rain and thunderstorms in contract locations with outdoor environments


Ecliptic Studios Dev Team

notes.title: Patch 0.8.7 (Demo) Is Now Live!
notes.notes:
What's Fixed?

 Dropping/Placing equipment at exactly the same time could cause both actions to occur.
 Inventory UI could be duplicated in contract with high latency connections.
 Intro sequence would stall contract progression indefinitely if a player failed to load into the contract in time.
 Unreachable Ethereal Artifact location in the Red Bedroom wardrobe closet.
 Mirror anomaly in master bathroom flipped on right mirror.
 Alive players could hear dead player footsteps.
 Players couldnt use Push-To-Talk when inside inventory containers in contract.
 Cellphone and tablet glass has graphical glitch which makes it appear that distorted for other players.
 Glass in modification garage had intense distortion causing graphical issues.


What's Changed?

 Contract Board is disabled for the demo (Can still be placed, no longer interacted with).
 Car alarm sound reduced by 50% and timer added to automatically shut off after set duration.
 Global Illumination has been temporarily disabled.
 Headlamp light intensity has been reduced by ~50% to avoid light hotspots (Balancing).
 Some event sting sounds were reduced along with the falloff distance.


What's New?

 Post Contract Stats now includes time spent in contract.
 Info prompts to audio input/output devices in settings.
 Added new task for Cleanse and Identify; "Capture a Flawless Ghost Photo".
 Added new photo anomaly type; "Environment Manipulation".

 Normal, average interactions are still not covered under this anomaly type. However, unique anomalies such as "HAPPY DEATHDAY" anomaly is.
 Added Official Discord app button on the laptop in the headquarters.
 Added Wishlist button on the laptop in the headquarters which will open the game's store page in the Steam overlay.
